messages.author: 00d33217ce2031fe
messages.subject: Observer detection covariate significant but only 2 of three observers have parameter values in model output...
parts:
Hi All,

I've run a gmultmix model with observer as a detection covariate included in the top model based on AIC.  In the model output there are parameter values and associated SE values for observer 2 and observer 3 but no such values for observer 1.  What do you think gives?

Thanks!

-Tim

Cheers
